prompt: Some feel that it is impossible for a country to be economically progressive and environmentally friendly at the same time. Others disagree with this view. Discuss both points of view and give your opinion.
essay:
Few people think that growing an economy and maintaining a clean environment cannot be done simultaneously, while some peers disapprove of this view. In the following paragraphs, I will discuss both perspectives and provide my own opinion, supported by relevant examples.

To begin with, it is evident that developing nations often contribute significantly to pollution due to industrial activities. Factories produce waste and frequently dispose of impurities in water bodies, leading to environmental degradation. For instance, reports from The New York Times indicate that air quality in many developing nations is severely affected by industrial emissions, with toxic gases contributing to 70% more pollution compared to other countries.

On the other hand, countries can adopt sustainable practices such as recycling waste, reusing materials, and minimizing processes that lead to waste. For example, a local cola company in China shared on Twitter how they recycle cans and bottles to create new ones. They also encourage customers to return empty packaging to stores so it can be sent to factories for recycling. This initiative demonstrates how businesses can contribute to environmental sustainability while continuing to grow.

In my opinion, environmental preservation should be prioritized even if it means slowing down economic advancements. If we do not address environmental issues, we risk depleting the resources necessary for future development. Therefore, sustainability should be an integral part of our growth strategies.

To sum up, while economic growth presents challenges to the environment, sustainable practices can help bridge the gap between development and environmental preservation. It is crucial for nations to balance these aspects to ensure a healthy and prosperous future.
